project.purpose: Describe current Skills-MCP bridge responsibilities evidenced by existing parser, scanner, catalog and MCP service APIs; no universal Skill registry or skill execution authority.

nodes.label: SkillPackageInterpretationAndScan
nodes.responsibility: Read a portable Skill package/frontmatter and report bounded trust/safety/format observations for candidate discovery.
nodes.authority: Agent Skills specification and existing Skills bridge
inputs: configured SkillSource and package files or SKILL.md text
outputs: parsed metadata and scan/eligibility observations or explicit invalid-package status
nodes.behavioralContract: Package scanners provide advisory and trust-input qualification, not execution authority or a proof that a Skill's instructions are true.
acceptance: SkillCatalog imports package parser, scanner and eligibility observations.
Malformed/untrusted packages may be reported but no external provider execution or global safety proof is established.

nodes.label: ContextualSkillCatalogResolution
nodes.responsibility: Rebuild skill inventory, select one exact context-dependent Skill binding and read its immutable package text under currentness fences.
nodes.authority: Skills discovery and exact binding authority
inputs: SkillSource inventory, optional workspace/agent context and exact resolution/search/read request
outputs: scoped Skill list, resolution and read result with source/package identities or qualified errors
nodes.behavioralContract: Resolve/search/read are context- and precedence-bound read operations; a skill's advisory text is not formal truth, not a grant and not an effect executor.
acceptance: skills_mcp.py imports SkillCatalog and serves its outputs.
Exact live user-installed package currentness is owned by the actual Skills service and not proven by the source plan.

nodes.label: PortableSkillsMcpPublication
nodes.responsibility: Expose existing SkillCatalog via the official MCP Python SDK and SEP-2640-compatible read/navigation surfaces.
inputs: configured CatalogProvider, MCP request and authorization context
outputs: MCP Tool/resource responses containing bounded Skill views or scoped errors
nodes.behavioralContract: Protocol transport and permission verification remain owned by official MCP/security mechanisms; publication neither executes a Skill nor makes its advice authoritative.
acceptance: Existing skills_mcp.py build_server uses CatalogProvider and registered MCP/SEP-2640 handlers.
skills_mcp_consumer_readiness.py exercises tool/resource consumer readiness, not exhaustive installed consumer acceptance.

gaps: Cross-service Agent/ChatGPT Skills consumer identity, installed currentness and complete dynamic consumers are not source-certified by this planning projection.
The Cloudflare tunnel helper and deployment lifecycle have separate operator and security consumers; further recursive qualification is required before promoting independent LEGO.
